title: Broken Covenants
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Every covenant has somebody standing up front, the One who saw the vow made. In Malachi 2 the priests corrupt the covenant of life and peace, God's people deal faithlessly at the altar and at the kitchen table, and a tired people ask where the God of justice went. The Witness never left His post. You broke it. He kept it. And the curse you earned, He wore.
subtitle: Malachi Week 2
